card.name: Start of nelfinavir in drug lists
card.fires_on: The letter n that begins the drug name nelfinavir (rarely nafcillin) in a list of interacting drugs. It follows a comma, 'or' or 'and' in CYP3A4 inhibitor or inducer lists.

modes.label: nelfinavir in inhibitor lists
modes.description: The first letter of nelfinavir inside a list of strong CYP3A4 inhibitors, often after ritonavir.
modes.example: ketoconazole and other strong inhibitors of CYP3A, such as itraconazole, nefazodone, ritonavir,<< n>>elfinavir, indinav

modes.label: Other n-drugs in lists
modes.description: The first letter of another n-drug such as nafcillin in an inducer list.

card.writes: It pushes toward the following letters of names that begin with n, such as nelfinavir, plus some name-like pieces in other scripts.
card.plain: It fires on the first letter of nelfinavir when it appears in a list of interacting drugs.
